messages:
jamal: Heads-up — staging just alerted: tokenizer regression on canary for v3.2.1-pin, latency spike ~120ms p95. rolling hold on eu-west1 canary.
deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] deploy request created by @jamal for hotfix v3.2.1-pin -> eu-west1. Change window: now -> +30m. Requires 2 expedited approvals to proceed. CI: quick-e2e passed, perf-checker flagged p95.
elaine: saw the spike in observability — looks like KV cache miss rate increased after this config. attaching trace id: trace/0a1b2c
ryan: can we quickswitch to previous tokenizer variant (v3.2.0-q) in the same pool as a fallback? that should remove the spike.
jamal: plan: 1) approve expedited pin, 2) deploy v3.2.1-pin to 10% canary with telemetry gate, 3) if p95 > 80ms or error-rate +0.5% for 3min -> automated fallback to v3.2.0-q, 4) document in release notes and postmortem if triggered.
natalie: +1 for telemetry gate. Need confirmation on rollback trigger thresholds and who does the manual cutoff if automation fails.
elaine: rollback thresholds: p95>80ms sustained 3m OR 5xx rate delta >0.5% absolute. If automation fails, @jamal will manually trigger rollback, ops-lead oncall paged.
deploy-bot: Approvals needed: 2. Approvals recorded: none. To approve, react with :thumbsup: or reply 'approve'.
ryan: approve — will monitor logs and hold on manual intervention.
jamal: approve. starting staged canary at 10% now. deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] starting canary rollout (v3.2.1-pin) -> eu-west1, cohort=10%. run: quicktrace + perf-sanity.
deploy-bot: [TELEMETRY] initial metrics: p95=62ms, kv-miss=1.2% (baseline 0.9%), errors unchanged.
elaine: good to watch KV cache warming, leave canary for 5m then re-evaluate.
ryan: I see small blips but under rollback thresholds. keeping eye on tail latency dashboards.
deploy-bot: [TELEMETRY] 4m in: p95=78ms, kv-miss=1.9%, 5xx delta +0.2%. still under automated rollback threshold.
natalie: documenting this in release notes draft: "Hotfix v3.2.1-pin — addresses tokenizer token-split bug. Deployed as 10% canary with telemetry gate; automated fallback to v3.2.0-q on latency/error regression." adding rollout owner: jamal.
deploy-bot: [TELEMETRY] 7m in: p95=86ms, 5xx delta +0.7% -> automated fallback initiated to v3.2.0-q.
jamal: observed automated fallback occur. initiating quick incident note and will open postmortem if regression persists.
elaine: confirm traffic shifted back to v3.2.0-q and kv-miss returning to baseline.
ryan: kv-miss down to 0.95%, p95=64ms. good.
natalie: thanks team. next steps: revert pin candidate, root-cause triage on KV invalidation, add extra integration test for tokenizer-cache interaction, and schedule a 1hr follow-up after full-day telemetry.
jamal: filing follow-up ticket and adding this thread to release notes as 'aborted rollout — fallback triggered'. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: [CLOSE] Canopy: hotfix v3.2.1-pin rollout aborted; fallback successful. Change window closed.
